# Worksheet Was Here

> > An educational resource blog providing worksheet answers and teaching materials across mathematics, science, and language arts subjects for K-12 students.

This site aggregates worksheet solutions and educational content from publishers like Kuta Software, Scholastic, Education.com, and Math-Aids.Com. The blog focuses on providing answer keys and teaching resources for common classroom worksheets spanning algebra, geometry, biology, chemistry, physics, and elementary reading comprehension.

## Mathematics Worksheets

- [Triangle Congruence SSS and SAS Worksheet](https://i-am-corona.blogspot.com/2022/12/42-triangle-congruence-sss-and-sas.html): Geometry worksheet on triangle congruence using SSS and SAS methods
- [Pythagorean Theorem Worksheet Answers](https://i-am-corona.blogspot.com/2022/12/45-pythagorean-theorem-worksheet-answers.html): Pythagorean theorem worksheet answers from Kuta Software resources
- [Right Triangle Trigonometry Worksheet Answers](https://i-am-corona.blogspot.com/2022/12/44-right-triangle-trigonometry.html): Right triangle trigonometry answers using SOHCAHTOA and Kuta Software
- [Simplifying Radical Expressions Worksheet Answers](https://i-am-corona.blogspot.com/2022/12/43-simplifying-radical-expressions.html): Algebra worksheet on simplifying radicals and exponents with answers
- [Permutations and Combinations Worksheet Answers](https://i-am-corona.blogspot.com/2022/12/45-permutations-and-combinations.html): Math worksheet on permutations and combinations with Khan Academy resources
- [Glencoe Algebra 2 Chapter 2 Worksheet Answers](https://i-am-corona.blogspot.com/2022/12/43-glencoe-algebra-2-chapter-2.html): Glencoe Algebra 2 Chapter 2 worksheet answers and practice problems
